context: A mom and her young son plan a weekend outing
purpose: Teach: カレンダー/シャツ/ファミリー/出かける/受け取る/早々/嬉しく/両手

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ翔、今度の週末、ファミリーで動物園に出かけるのはどう？
lines.en: Hey Sho, this coming weekend, how about going out to the zoo as a family?
lines.style: Bright, inviting maternal tone with warm casual enthusiasm throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わあ、行きたい！朝早々から出発しようよ！
lines.en: Wow, I want to go! Let's leave first thing in the morning!
lines.style: Excited childlike voice bursting with bouncy eager energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、じゃあカレンダーに丸を付けておこうね。
lines.en: Sure, then let's mark it on the calendar with a circle.
lines.style: Gentle, organized maternal tone with soft affectionate warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえママ、この前のシャツ着ていってもいい？
lines.en: Hey Mom, can I wear that shirt from the other day?
lines.style: Eager, slightly pleading child voice asking permission sweetly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もちろん。昨日ちょうど受け取ったばかりのやつだよね。
lines.en: Of course. It's the one we just received yesterday, right?
lines.style: Warm, knowing maternal voice with a gentle smile in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん！キリンを見たら、嬉しくて両手を振っちゃうかも。
lines.en: Yeah! When I see the giraffes, I might wave both hands from joy.
lines.style: Dreamy child voice full of innocent wonder and anticipation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、お弁当も作るし、駅で予約のチケットも受け取るから楽しみにしててね。
lines.en: Hehe, I'll make a bento and pick up the reserved tickets at the station too, so look forward to it.
lines.style: Soft, loving maternal promise delivered with a gentle smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やったあ！パパも一緒に行けるかな？
lines.en: Yay! I wonder if Daddy can come along too?
lines.style: Hopeful, curious child voice with rising upward intonation.
